items.title: Schuller Gunther — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He came to my house for regular lessons once a week.

ctx.x: Yeah, Eugene Wright. He came to my house for regular lessons once a week. Bill Evans came over for a lot of things. I’ll have to tell about that a little bit. All kinds of people, because they trusted me that, since I was so involved with jazz myself, I wouldn’t be teaching them nonsense or trying to get them away from jazz or something like that. They needed help in reading, in writing. Many of them wanted to compose, and they just didn’t know how to do it. They didn’t know any theory, either. Bird knew about…
